mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM growth > 1% does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of RSAFS and UNRATE does not correlate with strong economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of FEDFUNDS and PAYEMS does not correlate with accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS MoM increase > 200,000 does not correlate with strong job growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 YoY decrease > 1% does not correlate with a weakening economy.
